question.text: Q1, the only verdict question: do the three quoted SPY opening-bell win rates (51%, 53%, 54%) hold within our predeclared tolerance on this window/proxy? Q2-Q4 and every QQQ row are descriptive; not inferred.

source claim.text: The Rumers say, in their video published 2026-09-19, that buying SPY at the open and selling after an hour, two hours or at the end of the day wins 51%, 53% and 54% of the time. The spoken percentages are the registered comparators.

source unknowns.text: Exact source dates, the underlying trades, vendor, tie treatment, fill convention and whether costs were included are not supplied. Their on-screen table prints rates and win/loss/flat counts; their formula and trades are not verified.

window.text: 2011-07-01 through 2026-05-29 inclusive, fixed before returns. "Last 15 years" with the 2026-09-19 publication date suggests roughly September 2011 to September 2026: our inference, not exact source dates.

eligibility and coverage.text: Full scheduled regular sessions only (09:30-16:00 ET); early closes excluded by calendar, never by price. Coverage floors: at least 99% of full sessions overall and at least 90% in each represented calendar year, for both funds.

entry and three alternative exits.text: Long SPY at the first eligible print of the 09:30 minute; exit at the first print of the 10:30 or 11:30 minute, or the last eligible print of the 15:59 minute (our near-close proxy, not a certified closing-auction fill). One hypothetical trade per session per exit; the exits are alternative histories, never added together.

scheduled coordinate blocks 63/126/252.text: Uncertainty ranges use a calendar-block ratio cluster-t envelope with blocks of 63, 126 and 252 scheduled full sessions, keeping excluded-date coordinates and the final partial block. One trade per session does not make signs independent.

12 occupied-block minimum.text: Each block length requires at least 12 occupied blocks, a positive denominator and finite nonzero variance; otherwise the range is withheld.

alpha .05/6 each.text: The family is the three SPY win-rate members only, each at alpha = .05/6; no alpha moved from withdrawn money members. Above-half labels reuse the same three bounds.

two percentage-point frozen tolerance ba.text: Tolerance: two percentage points absolute, inclusive bands [49%, 53%], [51%, 55%] and [52%, 56%]. A point inside its band is WITHIN PREDECLARED TOLERANCE; a whole range inside is WITHIN BAND; a range wholly outside is DISJOINT; otherwise OVERLAPS BAND.

conjunction and half reuse.text: The claim holds only if 3 of 3 ranges are wholly inside their bands; it does not hold if at least one range is wholly outside; otherwise cannot tell. Above-half classifications reuse the same three bounds and answer a different question.

quantity fixed before buy.text: Whole shares q = floor(50/(0.01 x M)), with M the immediately preceding scheduled session's last regular-minute close, fixed at 09:29 ET before entry. $50 is a hypothetical stress budget against a 1% adverse move, not account capital, a stop or a maximum loss.

estimated cost grid.text: Primary expense $0.04 per share round trip plus $0 commission, once per trade: an estimate, not a quote. The full registered sweep has 72 cells per fund and exit: risk $20 or $50, adverse 0.5%, 1% or 2%, $0 to $0.20 per share and $0 or $1 commission.

no money inference.text: Money amounts are measured; descriptive; not inferred. A positive or negative sign is an observed sign, never a money verdict; the nine branch sentences were frozen before returns.

primary vs descriptive extensions.text: SPY Q1 is the only inferential question. Later-window comparisons (Q3), the overnight/intraday decomposition (B24), concentration, every cost cell and the added fund QQQ are descriptive; not inferred.

missing observations.text: No forward fill, zero return or nearest-bar substitution. Four official market-wide halt records are exemptions, not imputed prices; unknown gaps stay unknown.

one run and C01 custody.text: One registered outcome run at the lock; no rerun or post-price method change. A dated post-run descriptive correction, C01 (2026-10-18), recomputes the after-cost classes in exact decimal arithmetic, and with them the class counts, conditional win/loss means, ratios and signed medians; Q1 rates, bounds and labels, unconditional means and percentiles are unchanged. It is shown beside its locked predecessors.

reopen conditions.text: Holds needs 3 of 3 ranges wholly inside; any valid disjoint range would give does not hold. Exact source dates and the original ledger, actual order/fill and fee records, a verified error, or a fresh registration for a wider window or different method could change the reading.

summary scope.text: Summary, not the full plan text. Main terms only, paraphrased; not the complete private registry or a public immutable preregistration. The lock commit acc81d8 is held in a private repository; no public ref pins it. Hashes identify records; they are not public timestamp proof.
